name: hyaluronic acid + panthenol
purpose: Purpose Helps moisturize the nail surface, making your nails softer, more elastic and less likely to break.
uses: Use 1. Clean the nail surface and keep nails dry. 2. Apply an appropriate amount of this product evenly to the nail surface and the skin around the nails. 3. Gently massage to promote absorption.
otcwarn: Do not use Do not swallow. STOP USE Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur.
